about: Shipped with Looking Glass (attack_map.py). The SUGGESTED MITRE ATT&CK techniques for each Shadowserver report, from its name, type and group. The first rule that matches a report gives its suggestion, which a researcher confirms or changes on the Definitions page; a reviewed mapping is never replaced by a suggestion. certainty: observed = the report saw it happen; possible = an exposure an attacker could use. role: used = 'this device was used for ...'; target = 'this address was the target of ...'; host = 'this host was used for ...'; exposure = 'attackers can use this exposure for ...'. shortlist: the techniques the picker offers first. Reports no rule matches are 'not mapped yet' and are asked about on the Definitions page. Rules whose id starts with ss- were checked against the report's own Shadowserver page (2026-11-23, the remaining reports 2026-11-25; source = the page); nofit = the suggestion is that no ATT&CK technique fits.
